name: UUencode Encoding
description: Uuencode, short for ``Unix-to-Unix encoding``, is a binary-to-text encoding mechanism originally designed to transfer binary data over mediums that only support text, such as email or newsgroups. It encodes binary files into a text format that can be easily transmitted and decoded back into their original form.
code:
<?php

    $phpString = 'Well, I can say: 你好！' ;
    
    $encoded = convert_uuencode($phpString);
    print $encoded.PHP_EOL;
    //:5V5L;"P@22!C86X@<V%Y.B#DO:#EI;WOO($`
    //`
    
    $decoded = convert_uudecode($encoded);
    print $decoded.PHP_EOL;
    //Well, I can say: 你好！

?>
